subject: Status of ggvis for production application

messages.author: 5831ba4c430c0f7d
messages.subject: Status of ggvis for production application
parts:
Hi All,

I am working on a web visualisation project right now, and have started to use Shiny. For performance and functionality, I'd like to start using ggvis in stead of Shiny+ggplot2. My question is the following, how far along is ggvis in terms of being a product that could be used in a production setting? I know that it is in beta right now, but is there any time frame as to when the first stable release will be?

regards,
Paul

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Status of ggvis for production application
parts:
Hi Paul,

Unfortunately we're not currently ready to set a firm date - I'd
expect it'd be before the end of the year though.

Hadley

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Status of ggvis for production application
parts:
It depends on what you mean by production ready - for what it can do
it, works. But there's a lot it can't do yet, and in the process of
adding new features it's fairly likely that I'll change how some of
the functions work.

Hadley
